name: Bigle
description_en:
Bigle’s site distinguishes Bigle CLM, Libra legal AI, Sign and Academy. Document automation converts approved templates into forms, including conditions, calculations, reusable clauses and repeated sections. These are document-generation mechanisms, not an independent guarantee of legal correctness. Choose the CLM and add-on scope before assuming the suite name includes every product.

A documented pattern is to share selected form sections through a link so a counterparty can supply data and attachments. For a supplier agreement, legal could maintain the standard clauses, the requester fill commercial fields, and the supplier complete its own details. The automation page says reusable clause changes update templates using them, and self-service downloads can be restricted to PDF. Pilot a clause change and external-link permissions before broad reuse; already signed documents should be treated separately from template updates.
description_zh:
Bigle 官网区分 Bigle CLM、Libra 法律 AI、Sign 与 Academy。文件自动化把批准模板转为表单，包含条件、计算、可复用条款及重复段落。这些是文件生成机制，不是独立的法律正确性保证。应先选择 CLM 与附加范围，不能因套件名称就假定包含所有产品。

文档中的模式是通过链接分享指定表单区段，让交易对方提供资料与附件。以供应商合同为例，法务维护标准条款，申请人填商务字段，供应商补自己的信息。自动化页说明复用条款变更会更新采用它的模板，自助下载可限制为 PDF。广泛复用前应试验条款变更及外部链接权限；已签文件应与模板更新分别处理。

items.en: Bigle fits organizations that repeatedly generate controlled documents and need form-based self-service. A simple signing request may need a smaller scope, while complex negotiated language still needs legal ownership. Terms describe licensed software access and prohibit sharing account credentials. Exact deployment alternatives, source licensing, signing-failure recovery and the scope of bulk clause updates were not verified. Compare the generated file, permissions and audit history after a representative failed approval before rollout.
items.zh: Bigle 适合反复生成受控文件并需要表单自助的组织。简单签名请求可能只需较小范围，复杂谈判文本仍需法务负责。条款描述软件许可访问并禁止共享账户凭据。具体部署选项、源代码许可、签署失败恢复及批量条款更新范围尚未核实。上线前应使用代表性的批准失败案例，对照生成文件、权限与审计历史。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The official page groups Starter up to four users, Premium five to nine and Enterprise ten or more, with two GB storage per user. It also contains €35/month and €59/month figures in alternate sections without an unambiguous per-seat or total basis. One table says unlimited biometric signatures while another Starter block says ten signed documents/month. Do not normalize either figure into a payable price or universal allowance. Libra has separate Basic/Pro token and daily-query limits. Request a written quote and entitlement list; no continuing free tier or trial duration was confirmed.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 官方页面把 Starter 分为最多四用户、Premium 五至九用户、Enterprise 十用户以上，每用户两 GB 存储。另一区段出现每月 35 与 59 欧元，但未明确按席位还是总价。一张表称生物识别签名无限，另一 Starter 区块称每月十份签署文件。不能把任一数字归一为应付价格或统一额度。Libra 另有 Basic／Pro token 与每日查询上限。应索取书面报价及权益清单，未确认长期免费层或试用期限。
